name: patient_has_undergone_collection_of_stool_specimen_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a collection of stool specimen (fecal sample).

name: patient_has_undergone_collection_of_stool_specimen_inthehistory@@outcome_is_positive_for_clostridium_difficile_toxin
meaning: Boolean indicating that the patient's collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) was positive for Clostridium difficile toxin.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) was positive for Clostridium difficile toxin.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) was not positive for Clostridium difficile toxin.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's collection of stool specimen (fecal sample) was positive for Clostridium difficile toxin.

name: patient_has_received_treatment_for_clostridium_difficile_colitis_with_oral_metronidazole_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever received treatment for Clostridium difficile colitis with oral metronidazole at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever received treatment for Clostridium difficile colitis with oral metronidazole at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never received treatment for Clostridium difficile colitis with oral metronidazole at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever received treatment for Clostridium difficile colitis with oral metronidazole at any time in the past.

name: patient_metronidazole_containing_product_in_oral_dose_form_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_days
meaning: Numeric value representing the total number of days the patient has received oral metronidazole-containing product therapy at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if the total number of days of oral metronidazole-containing product therapy received in the past for Clostridium difficile colitis is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the total number of days the patient has received oral metronidazole-containing product therapy at any time in the past, specifically for the treatment of Clostridium difficile colitis.

name: patient_metronidazole_containing_product_in_oral_dose_form_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_days@@for_treatment_of_clostridium_difficile_colitis
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the recorded duration of oral metronidazole-containing product therapy was for the treatment of Clostridium difficile colitis.
when_true: Set to true if the recorded duration of oral metronidazole-containing product therapy was specifically for the treatment of Clostridium difficile colitis.
when_false: Set to false if the recorded duration was not for the treatment of Clostridium difficile colitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the therapy was for the treatment of Clostridium difficile colitis.
